# TPC-Havoc Q13_v8

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    c_count,
    count(*) as custdist
from (
    select
        c_custkey,
        (select count(*)
         from orders o
         where o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
           and not exists (
               select 1
               where o.o_comment like '%special%requests%'
           )) as c_count
    from customer c
) as c_orders
group by
    c_count
order by
    custdist desc,
    c_count desc
```
